The method / Capture the idea / Step 1
ACTION 01 OF 32 · PHASE 01

Open a dedicated ChatGPT Project

Keep all decisions and research for one venture in one consistent context.

WHEN TO DO THISImmediately after the idea is worth documenting.ESTIMATED WORK TIME10 min
↗
Your one job

Keep all decisions and research for one venture in one consistent context.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Open ChatGPT and create a new Project for this business. A Project is the organized workspace; it is not simply a folder on your computer.

  2. 02

    Name it with the working business name. Add a short description of the offer, audience and country.

  3. 03

    Put an initial idea summary, relevant notes, photos, links and existing financial figures into the Project's files or a clearly named companion Drive folder.

  4. 04

    Keep separate chats for research, finances, branding, website, legal questions and the decision log. Don't mix unrelated ventures in one Project.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
I am starting a business called [WORKING NAME] in [COUNTRY]. The concept is [IDEA]. I think the customer is [WHO], the problem is [PROBLEM], and the possible offer is [OFFER]. I can initially invest [BUDGET] and spend [HOURS/WEEK]. Ask me only the questions needed to complete a factual one-page Business Source of Truth. Separate confirmed facts, assumptions and open questions. Do not fabricate any numbers, competitors or customer evidence.
03

Finish with this

One named ChatGPT Project containing your raw business brief.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Project is named and separated from other ventures
  • A one-page source-of-truth brief exists
  • Missing facts are marked as missing
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Don't assume a ChatGPT Project verifies your idea or automatically owns documents in Google Drive.
